title: Role Contextualization & Member Impact Preview (simulation-first editor)
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Design and prototype a role editor experience that foregrounds a member-centric 'preview' and simulation workflow. The main goal is to let admins create or edit roles while immediately understanding the real-world impact on members and resources (projects, models, Dedicated pools) before saving. This doc captures the UX flows, trade-offs, acceptance criteria, and links to mockups and technical constraints for RBAC v2 in Console.
background: Administrators frequently express uncertainty when editing roles: which members will gain/lose access, what scoped resources are affected, and whether changes will trigger audit events or SSO mapping updates. Existing role editor screens are permission-first (checkbox matrix) with limited member context. This ticket proposes a simulation-first surface with live previews, diff view, and clear audit/SSO callouts to reduce errors and post-change incidents.
goals: Enable admins to preview the precise effect of a role change on selected members and resources before committing
Reduce misconfiguration incidents by surfacing conflicts (e.g., privilege escalation, overlapping roles) inline
Expose audit logging behavior and SSO/SAML mapping implications in the edit flow
Ship an accessible, keyboard-first editor that scales across large orgs with many members
non_goals: Replace bulk role management matrix (separate ticket)
Complex policy expression language UI (out of scope for launch)
user_flows: Start from Roles list -> Edit role -> Top-level preview card shows 'Affected members' count, top affected resources, and risk level
Open interactive preview: select individual members or groups to see their current vs. projected permissions and example API/Console actions they can perform
See a diff panel that highlights additive vs. subtractive permission changes, and immediate flags for higher-risk changes
If role changes intersect SSO group mappings, show an inline SSO callout and link to SSO mapping editor
Before Save: show expected audit log entries that will be generated, and offer an optional 'dry-run' API call for Dedicated/Private customers
key_interactions: Top preview summary with horizontal micro-graph of affected resource types
Member selector with live search and lazy-loading for orgs >10k members
Permission diff rows: current / proposed / effect badge (Added/Removed/No change)
Risk badge that computes a heuristic score (privilege-scope x critical-resource) and explains why
Save CTA guarded by a 'Show audit preview' modal when risk > medium
tradeoffs_and_decisions: Live simulation vs. performance: decided to limit live preview to first 200 members and provide a 'simulate in background' batch for large orgs (backend ENG-24108) to avoid blocking the UI
Scope of preview: we will show examples of 'exemplar' resources (top 10 by traffic/cost) rather than enumerating every resource to keep the panel readable
Risk heuristics: opted for a conservative default that errs on flagging potentially risky changes; allow admins to tune thresholds in settings (future work)
SSO/Mapping visibility: UX will link to the SSO mapping editor rather than allow full editing inline to limit blast radius for initial rollout
accessibility_considerations: All diff rows use semantic tables with clear headers for screen readers
Risk badges include textual explanations and ids for color-blind users
Keyboard-first navigation for member selector and diff expansion panels
ARIA live regions for background simulation completion notifications
acceptance_criteria: Admins can open the role editor, modify permissions, and see a per-member preview for up to 200 members without noticeable lag
Diff view clearly shows added and removed permissions and links affected resources
SSO mapping intersection displays when role changes touch groups mapped via SAML/SCIM
Audit preview modal lists the expected audit log entries (action, target, actor) that will be written post-change
Design sign-off from Security and PM teams and usability test NPS >= 40 across 8 sessions
implementation_notes: Backend: ENG-24108 implements member simulation API and streaming results; ENG-24109 adds audit-entry forecast endpoint
Limit live queries to 200 members; show 'Simulating for remaining members' toast and provide background simulation link
Cache exemplar resource list per org to avoid repeated heavy queries; tie to metrics for cost-sensitive tenants
Design will provide Figma components and tokenized CSS variables to match Console theming
risks: Performance regressions for very large orgs if background simulation isn't optimized
False positives from conservative risk heuristics may frustrate power users
SSO mapping complexities across multiple identity providers could create edge cases not covered by initial implementation
qa_plan: Create automated E2E tests that modify roles and assert generated audit-preview payloads
Run performance tests with synthetic orgs of 50k members to validate background simulation behavior
Invite 6 internal customers to open beta and collect issue reports for 2 weeks
rollout_plan: Feature-flagged rollout to 20% of orgs for 2 weeks with metrics on time-to-save and incidents
If metrics stable, expand to 100% and remove feature flag after one maintenance window
Provide admin-facing doc describing simulation limits and how audit previews work
